turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Well, I guess what finally got me here is that I'm just having a really hard time keeping my focus at work. I'm an electrician, so I have to do a lot of estimates and fill out code forms, but lately I just can't stick with one thing. Like, if I hear a tool noise, or my phone buzzes with a text, or even if I just get a new idea about organizing the workshop... I just get completely pulled off track. It's starting to cause problems because jobs are getting mixed up, and I really can't afford for that to happen.
